mapper.select: -- 생성/선택 변경의 동일 키를 짧게 직렬화한다. 외부 호출을 하지 않는다. SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtextextended(CAST(#{key} AS text),73106))::text
-- 재요청은 기존 snapshot을 반환하며 현재 선택을 되돌리지 않는다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_batch_previews p WHERE p.idempotency_key=#{key}
-- 다른 배치의 이력을 가져올 수 없다. SELECT FROM announcement_attachment_batch_previews p WHERE p.batch_id=#{batchId} AND p.id=#{previewId}
mapper.sql: -- 고정 jobs 전체와 불변 봉인 metadata만 조회한다. 원문/추출 텍스트·URL·파일 표시명·최신 재추출을 섞지 않는다. SELECT j.id AS job_id,j.source_id,j.frozen_provider_code AS provider_code,j.job_status_code,j.error_code, (sealed.set_status_code='SEALED' AND sealed.is_discovery_complete AND sealed.processed_count=sealed.discovered_count AND sealed.discovered_count=files.file_count AND files.file_count<=10 AND files.input_count=files.file_count AND files.download_failed_count=0 AND files.incomplete_count=0 AND e.id IS NOT NULL AND j.preview_hash IS NOT NULL) AS evidence_complete, (s.data_purpose_code='PRODUCTION' AND s.semantic_status_code<>'EXCLUDED' AND base.is_current AND base.decision_status_code<>'EXCLUDED' AND base.title_stage_code IN ('GROUP_A_MATCHED','COMBINATION_MATCHED') AND s.classification_row_version=j.expected_source_version AND s.attachment_row_version=j.expected_attachment_version AND attachment_batch_job_input_unchanged(j.id)) AS frozen_source_current, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_links l WHERE l.source_id=j.source_id) AS protected_link, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_jobs other WHERE other.source_id=j.source_id AND other.id<>j.id AND other.job_status_code IN ('SCOPE_READY','PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','PAUSED')) AS active_other_job, jsonb_build_object('baseId',j.base_evaluation_id,'contentId',j.content_version_id,'ruleId',j.rule_release_id,'policyId',j.policy_id, 'setId',j.set_id,'evaluationId',j.preview_evaluation_id,'jobPreviewHash',j.preview_hash,'jobRequestHash',j.request_hash, 'expectedSourceVersion',j.expected_source_version,'expectedAttachmentVersion',j.expected_attachment_version, 'sourceVersion',s.classification_row_version,'attachmentVersion',s.attachment_row_version,'baseCurrent',base.is_current, 'currentEvaluationId',s.current_attachment_evaluation_id,'currentPolicyId',s.attachment_policy_id,'reviewRequired',s.is_attachment_review_required,'baseReviewStatus',s.review_status_code, 'currentConfirmationId',(SELECT c.id FROM announcement_source_attachment_confirmations c WHERE c.source_id=j.source_id AND c.is_current), 'locatorHash',attachment_source_locator_hash(j.source_id),'manifestHash',sealed.manifest_hash, 'evaluationInputHash',e.input_hash,'evaluationDecisionHash',e.decision_hash)::text AS input_json, jsonb_build_object('baseEvaluationId',j.base_evaluation_id,'setId',sealed.id,'evaluationId',e.id, 'ruleReleaseId',j.rule_release_id,'ruleVersion',r.version_no,'ruleHash',r.rule_snapshot_hash,'policyMode',policy.mode_code, 'baseStatus',base.decision_status_code,'baseReviewStatus',s.review_status_code,'previousAttachmentStatus',previous.decision_status_code, 'previousReviewRequired',j.previous_is_review_required,'hasPreviousConfirmation',j.previous_confirmation_id IS NOT NULL, 'proposedStatus',e.decision_status_code,'reasonCode',e.reason_code,'warningCodes',coalesce(e.warning_codes_json,'[]'::jsonb), 'discoveryStatus',sealed.discovery_status_code,'discoveryComplete',sealed.is_discovery_complete,'fileCount',files.file_count, 'discoveredCount',sealed.discovered_count,'processedCount',sealed.processed_count, 'downloadFailedCount',files.download_failed_count,'incompleteExtractionCount',files.incomplete_count,'unknownRoleCount',files.unknown_count, 'files',files.file_json, 'baseTargetCodes',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(c.category_code ORDER BY c.category_code) FROM announcement_source_classification_target_matches m JOIN announcement_target_categories c ON c.id=m.target_category_id WHERE m.evaluation_id=j.base_evaluation_id),'[]'::jsonb), 'baseSupportCodes',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(c.support_type_code ORDER BY c.support_type_code) FROM announcement_source_classification_support_matches m JOIN announcement_support_types c ON c.id=m.support_type_id WHERE m.evaluation_id=j.base_evaluation_id),'[]'::jsonb), 'previousTargetCodes',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(c.category_code ORDER BY c.category_code) FROM announcement_source_attachment_tags t JOIN announcement_target_categories c ON c.id=t.target_category_id WHERE t.evaluation_id=j.previous_attachment_evaluation_id AND t.origin_code='AUTO'),'[]'::jsonb), 'previousSupportCodes',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(c.support_type_code ORDER BY c.support_type_code) FROM announcement_source_attachment_tags t JOIN announcement_support_types c ON c.id=t.support_type_id WHERE t.evaluation_id=j.previous_attachment_evaluation_id AND t.origin_code='AUTO'),'[]'::jsonb), 'confirmedTargetCodes',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(c.category_code ORDER BY c.category_code) FROM announcement_source_attachment_tags t JOIN announcement_target_categories c ON c.id=t.target_category_id WHERE t.confirmation_id=j.previous_confirmation_id AND t.origin_code='CONFIRMED'),'[]'::jsonb), 'confirmedSupportCodes',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(c.support_type_code ORDER BY c.support_type_code) FROM announcement_source_attachment_tags t JOIN announcement_support_types c ON c.id=t.support_type_id WHERE t.confirmation_id=j.previous_confirmation_id AND t.origin_code='CONFIRMED'),'[]'::jsonb), 'proposedTargetCodes',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(c.category_code ORDER BY c.category_code) FROM announcement_source_attachment_tags t JOIN announcement_target_categories c ON c.id=t.target_category_id WHERE t.evaluation_id=j.preview_evaluation_id AND t.origin_code='AUTO'),'[]'::jsonb), 'proposedSupportCodes',coalesce((SELECT jsonb_agg(c.support_type_code ORDER BY c.support_type_code) FROM announcement_source_attachment_tags t JOIN announcement_support_types c ON c.id=t.support_type_id WHERE t.evaluation_id=j.preview_evaluation_id AND t.origin_code='AUTO'),'[]'::jsonb))::text AS evidence_json FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j JOIN announcement_source_snapshots s ON s.id=j.source_id JOIN announcement_source_classification_evaluations base ON base.id=j.base_evaluation_id AND base.source_id=j.source_id JOIN announcement_source_classification_rule_releases r ON r.id=j.rule_release_id JOIN announcement_attachment_policies policy ON policy.id=j.policy_id LEFT JOIN announcement_source_attachment_evaluations previous ON previous.id=j.previous_attachment_evaluation_id AND previous.source_id=j.source_id LEFT JOIN announcement_source_attachment_sets sealed ON sealed.id=j.set_id AND sealed.source_id=j.source_id AND sealed.content_version_id=j.content_version_id AND sealed.policy_id=j.policy_id AND sealed.set_status_code='SEALED' LEFT JOIN announcement_source_attachment_evaluations e ON e.id=j.preview_evaluation_id AND e.source_id=j.source_id AND e.set_id=sealed.id AND e.base_evaluation_id=j.base_evaluation_id AND e.content_version_id=j.content_version_id AND e.rule_release_id=j.rule_release_id AND e.policy_id=j.policy_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(f.id) AS file_count,count(i.file_id) AS input_count, count(f.id) FILTER (WHERE f.download_status_code<>'SUCCEEDED') AS download_failed_count, count(f.id) FILTER (WHERE x.quality_code IS DISTINCT FROM 'COMPLETE_TEXT') AS incomplete_count, count(f.id) FILTER (WHERE f.document_role_code='UNKNOWN') AS unknown_count, coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('fileId',f.id,'extractionId',i.extraction_id,'format',f.detected_type_code, 'role',f.document_role_code,'downloadStatus',f.download_status_code,'quality',x.quality_code, 'downloadErrorCode',f.error_code,'extractionErrorCode',x.error_code) ORDER BY f.sort_order,f.id),'[]'::jsonb) AS file_json FROM (SELECT original.id,original.set_id,original.source_id,original.sort_order,original.detected_type_code, original.document_role_code,original.download_status_code,original.error_code FROM announcement_source_attachment_files original WHERE original.set_id=sealed.id AND original.source_id=j.source_id ORDER BY original.sort_order,original.id LIMIT 11) f LEFT JOIN announcement_source_attachment_evaluation_inputs i ON i.evaluation_id=j.preview_evaluation_id AND i.source_id=f.source_id AND i.set_id=f.set_id AND i.file_id=f.id LEFT JOIN announcement_source_attachment_extractions x ON x.id=i.extraction_id AND x.source_id=f.source_id AND x.set_id=f.set_id AND x.file_id=f.id WHERE f.set_id=sealed.id AND f.source_id=j.source_id ) files ON true WHERE j.batch_id=#{batchId}
mapper.select: -- 저장 당시 metadata/선택을 그대로 반환한다. 삭제된 job/source의 ID를 복원하지 않는다. SELECT i.job_id,j.source_id,j.frozen_provider_code AS provider_code,i.readiness_code,i.is_eligible,i.is_selected,i.input_hash,i.evidence_json::text AS evidence_json FROM announcement_attachment_batch_preview_items i JOIN announcement_attachment_jobs j ON j.id=i.job_id AND j.batch_id=i.batch_id WHERE i.preview_id=#{previewId} ORDER BY j.source_id,i.job_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
-- 과거 snapshot 당시 수와 현재 남은 항목 수를 구분한다. SELECT count(1) FROM announcement_attachment_batch_preview_items WHERE preview_id=#{previewId}
mapper.update: -- 하나의 짧은 transaction에서만 선택/새 이력을 작성한다. 미완료 수집은 preview로 넘기지 않는다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_batches SET batch_status_code='PREVIEW_RUNNING',row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{batchId} AND row_version=#{expectedVersion} AND batch_status_code IN ('COLLECTED','COLLECTION_PARTIAL_FAILED','PREVIEW_READY','PREVIEW_PARTIAL_FAILED')
mapper.insert: -- 새 선택도 append-only 승인 근거다. 기존 preview를 덮어쓰지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_batch_previews(id,batch_id,preview_status_code,scope_hash,input_hash,preview_hash,batch_version, scope_item_count,remaining_item_count,deleted_item_count,eligible_item_count,selected_item_count,actor_id,idempotency_key,request_hash,reason_hash) VALUES (#{previewId},#{batchId},#{statusCode},#{scopeHash},#{inputHash},#{previewHash},#{batchVersion}, #{itemCount},#{remainingItemCount},#{deletedItemCount},#{eligibleItemCount},#{selectedItemCount},#{actorId},#{idempotencyKey},#{requestHash},#{reasonHash})

-- source identity는 삭제 cascade되는 job FK로만 연결한다. 근거 텍스트/주소는 복사하지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_attachment_batch_preview_items(preview_id,batch_id,job_id,readiness_code,is_eligible,is_selected,input_hash,evidence_json) VALUES (#{previewId},#{batchId},#{jobId},#{readinessCode},#{eligible},#{selected},#{inputHash},CAST(#{evidenceJson} AS jsonb))
mapper.update: -- 명시적으로 선택한 성공 항목만 표시한다. 비선택/실패 항목도 jobs와 preview 이력에 남긴다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_jobs SET is_selected_for_application= id IN #{id}false, row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE batch_id=#{batchId}

-- preview 확정이지 현재 판정 적용이 아니다. pointer와 선택 지문을 함께 고정한다. UPDATE announcement_attachment_batches SET batch_status_code=#{statusCode},preview_hash=#{previewHash},current_preview_id=#{previewId},row_version=row_version+1,updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{batchId} AND row_version=#{expectedVersion} AND batch_status_code='PREVIEW_RUNNING'
